intro.en: Karim has a stomach ache, and his friend Umar tells him how honey helped him as a child. Notice how «لَمْ» + a short verb makes a past 'not': لَمْ أَشْتَرِ (I did not buy).
intro.ur: Karim ke pet mein dard hai aur uska dost Umar bataata hai ke bachpan mein shahd se kaise faida hua. Dhyan dein: «لَمْ» ke baad chhota fe'l maazi ki nafi deta hai: لَمْ أَشْتَرِ (maine nahi khareeda).
intro.ar: يَشْكو كَريمٌ مِنْ أَلَمٍ في بَطْنِهِ، فَيَحْكي لَهُ صَديقُهُ عُمَرُ عَنِ العَسَلِ. لاحِظْ أَنَّ «لَمْ» مَعَ فِعْلٍ قَصيرٍ تَدُلُّ عَلى نَفْيِ الماضي، مِثْلَ: لَمْ أَشْتَرِ.

dialogue.ar: ما بِكَ يا كَريمُ؟ هَلْ أَنْتَ مَريضٌ؟
dialogue.tr: mā bika yā karīmu? hal anta marīḍun?
dialogue.en: What is wrong, Karim? Are you ill?
dialogue.ur: Kya hua Karim? Kya aap bimar hain?

dialogue.ar: نَعَمْ، عِنْدي آلامٌ شَديدَةٌ في بَطْني مُنْذُ الصَّباحِ.
dialogue.tr: naʿam, ʿindī ālāmun shadīdatun fī baṭnī mundhu ṣ-ṣabāḥi.
dialogue.en: Yes, I have severe pains in my belly since the morning.
dialogue.ur: Jee haan, subah se mere pet mein shadeed dard hai.

dialogue.ar: هَلْ رَأَيْتَ الطَّبيبَ؟
dialogue.tr: hal ra'ayta ṭ-ṭabība?
dialogue.en: Have you seen the doctor?
dialogue.ur: Kya aapne doctor ko dikhaya?

dialogue.ar: لا، لَمْ أَرَهُ، وَلَمْ أَشْتَرِ أَيَّ دَواءٍ.
dialogue.tr: lā, lam arahu, walam ashtari ayya daw'in.
dialogue.en: No, I did not see him, and I did not buy any medicine.
dialogue.ur: Nahi, maine unhein nahi dikhaya aur koi dawa bhi nahi khareedi.

dialogue.ar: كانَتْ جَدَّتي تَسْقيني العَسَلَ حينَ تُؤْلِمُني مَعِدَتي، فَأُشْفى بِإِذْنِ اللهِ.
dialogue.tr: kānat jaddatī tasqīnī l-ʿasala ḥīna tu'limunī maʿidatī, fa'ushfā bi'idhni llāh.
dialogue.en: When my stomach hurt, my grandmother used to give me honey to drink, and I was cured, by Allah's permission.
dialogue.ur: Jab mera meda dard karta tha to meri nani mujhe shahd pilati thin aur main Allah ke hukm se theek ho jata tha.

dialogue.ar: العَسَلُ؟ وَهَلْ شُفِيتَ في كُلِّ مَرَّةٍ؟
dialogue.tr: al-ʿasalu? wahal shufīta fī kulli marratin?
dialogue.en: Honey? And were you cured every time?
dialogue.ur: Shahd? Aur kya aap har baar theek ho jate the?

dialogue.ar: نَعَمْ، وَاللهُ هُوَ الشّافي. وَقَدْ قالَ تَعالى عَنِ العَسَلِ: ﴿فِيهِ شِفَاءٌ لِّلنَّاسِ﴾.
dialogue.tr: naʿam, wal-lhu huwa sh-shāfī. waqad qāla taʿālā ʿani l-ʿasali: fīhi shifā'un lilnnāsi.
dialogue.en: Yes, and Allah is the One who heals. Allah the Most High said about honey: 'In it is a cure for people.'
dialogue.ur: Jee haan, aur shifa dene wala Allah hai. Allah Ta'ala ne shahd ke baare mein farmaya: 'Is mein logon ke liye shifa hai.'

dialogue.ar: سُبْحانَ اللهِ! سَأَشْرَبُ العَسَلَ مَعَ الماءِ الدّافِئِ.
dialogue.tr: subḥāna llāh! sa'ashrabu l-ʿasala maʿa l-mā'i d-dāfi'i.
dialogue.en: Glory be to Allah! I will drink honey with warm water.
dialogue.ur: SubhanAllah! Main shahd garam paani ke saath piunga.

dialogue.ar: وَإِنْ لَمْ يَزُلِ الأَلَمُ فَلا تَتَأَخَّرْ عَنِ الطَّبيبِ.
dialogue.tr: wa'in lam yazuli l-'alamu falā tata'akhkhar ʿani ṭ-ṭabībi.
dialogue.en: And if the pain does not go away, do not delay seeing the doctor.
dialogue.ur: Aur agar dard door na ho to doctor ke paas jaane mein der na karna.

dialogue.ar: عِنْدَكَ حَقٌّ. هَلْ تَعْرِفُ مَكاناً أَشْتَري مِنْهُ عَسَلاً جَيِّداً؟
dialogue.tr: ʿindaka ḥaqqun. hal taʿrifu makānan ashtarī minhu ʿasalan jayyidan?
dialogue.en: You are right. Do you know a place where I can buy good honey?
dialogue.ur: Aap theek kehte hain. Kya aap koi jagah jaante hain jahan se main achha shahd khareed sakun?

dialogue.ar: في سُوقِ الحَيِّ مَحَلٌّ يَبيعُ عَسَلاً طَيِّباً.
dialogue.tr: fī sūqi l-ḥayyi maḥallun yabīʿu ʿasalan ṭayyiban.
dialogue.en: In the neighbourhood market there is a shop that sells good honey.
dialogue.ur: Mohalle ke bazaar mein ek dukan hai jo achha shahd bechti hai.

dialogue.ar: سَأَذْهَبُ إِلَيْهِ بَعْدَ الظُّهْرِ.
dialogue.tr: sa'adhhabu ilayhi baʿda ẓ-ẓuhri.
dialogue.en: I will go to it after noon.
dialogue.ur: Main zohar ke baad wahan jaunga.

dialogue.ar: شَفاكَ اللهُ يا صَديقي.
dialogue.tr: shafāka llāh yā ṣadīqī.
dialogue.en: May Allah cure you, my friend.
dialogue.ur: Allah aapko shifa de, mere dost.

dialogue.ar: بارَكَ اللهُ فيكَ.
dialogue.tr: bāraka llāh fīka.
dialogue.en: May Allah bless you.
dialogue.ur: Allah aapko barkat de.

q.ur: Karim ko kya mehsoos hota hai?

q.en: What does «لَمْ أَشْتَرِ أَيَّ دَواء» mean?
q.ur: «لَمْ أَشْتَرِ أَيَّ دَواء» ka kya matlab hai?

options: I did not buy any medicine

q.en: What does Karim say at the end?
q.ur: Karim aakhir mein kya kehta hai?
q.ar: ماذا يَقولُ كَريمٌ في نِهايَةِ الحِوارِ؟

q.ur: 'Shahd' ke liye kaun sa lafz hai?
q.ar: ما الكَلِمَةُ الَّتي تَدُلُّ عَلى الشَّيْءِ الحُلْوِ الَّذي يُنْتِجُهُ النَّحْلُ؟

q.en: When will Karim go to the shop?

intro.en: Hamza (أ) is a real sound that comes with a vowel (a, i, u). Alif (ا) is a long 'aa' sound and always has sukoon. Listen and compare: أَخَذَ, قَرَأَ, بَدا.
intro.ur: Hamza (أ) ek asal aawaz hai jo harkat (zabar, zer, pesh) ke saath aati hai. Alif (ا) lambi 'aa' ki aawaz hai aur hamesha saakin hoti hai. Suniye aur muqabla kijiye: أَخَذَ، قَرَأَ، بَدا.
intro.ar: الهَمْزَةُ (أ) صَوْتٌ حَقيقِيٌّ يَأْتي مَعَ حَرَكَةٍ، أَمّا الأَلِفُ (ا) فَهِيَ صَوْتُ مَدٍّ طَويلٍ وَتَكونُ ساكِنَةً دائِماً. اِسْمَعْ وَقارِنْ: أَخَذَ، قَرَأَ، بَدا.

q.en: Which sign is a sound that takes a vowel?
q.ur: Kaun si alamat harkat ke saath aati hai?

q.en: Which word has hamza at the START?
q.ur: Kis lafz ke shuru mein hamza hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ كَلِمَةٍ فيها الهَمْزَةُ في أَوَّلِها؟

q.en: Which word has hamza at the END?
q.ur: Kis lafz ke aakhir mein hamza hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ كَلِمَةٍ فيها الهَمْزَةُ في آخِرِها؟

q.en: Which word has hamza in the MIDDLE?
q.ur: Kis lafz ke beech mein hamza hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ كَلِمَةٍ فيها الهَمْزَةُ في وَسَطِها؟

intro.en: Prepositions (حُروفُ الجَرِّ) come before a noun: مِنْ، في، إِلَى، عَلَى، عَنْ، بِ، لِ. Example: ذَهَبْتُ إِلَى الطَّبيبِ (I went to the doctor).
intro.ur: Huroof-e-jar ism se pehle aate hain: مِنْ، في، إِلَى، عَلَى، عَنْ، بِ، لِ. Misaal: ذَهَبْتُ إِلَى الطَّبيبِ (main doctor ke paas gaya).
intro.ar: حُروفُ الجَرِّ تَأْتي قَبْلَ الاسْمِ وَتَجُرُّهُ، وَمِنْها: مِنْ، في، إِلَى، عَلَى، عَنْ، بِ، لِ. مِثالٌ: ذَهَبْتُ إِلَى الطَّبيبِ.

q.ur: 'Ki taraf' ka matlab kaun sa harf hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ حَرْفٍ يُفيدُ الاتِّجاهَ وَانْتِهاءَ الغايَةِ؟

q.en: Complete: الأَلَمُ ___ البَطْنِ (the pain is in the stomach)

q.ur: 'Se' ka matlab kaun sa harf hai?

q.en: What do prepositions do to the noun after them?
q.ur: Huroof-e-jar ism ko kya karte hain?
q.ar: ماذا تَفْعَلُ حُروفُ الجَرِّ بِالاسْمِ الَّذي بَعْدَها؟

options: They put it in the jarr (kasra) case

intro.en: Practise saying where it hurts and what you did. Example: أَشْعُرُ بِأَلَمٍ في بَطْني (I feel pain in my stomach). Then describe the pictures with a friend.
intro.ur: Mashq: dard kahan hai aur aapne kya kiya. Misaal: أَشْعُرُ بِأَلَمٍ في بَطْني (mujhe pet mein dard hai). Phir apne dost ke saath tasveerein bayan karein.
intro.ar: تَدَرَّبْ عَلى أَنْ تَقولَ أَيْنَ يُؤْلِمُكَ جِسْمُكَ وَماذا فَعَلْتَ، مِثْلَ: أَشْعُرُ بِأَلَمٍ في بَطْني. ثُمَّ صِفِ الصُّوَرَ مَعَ صَديقِكَ.

q.en: How do you say 'I took the medicine'?

intro.en: A reading text about two friends. Sara is very thin and wants to gain weight; Huda is heavy and wants to lose weight. Notice the dual: صَديقَتانِ (two female friends).
intro.ur: Do saheliyon ke baare mein ek parhne ka matan. Sara bohat dubli hai aur wazan barhana chahti hai; Huda mota hai aur wazan kam karna chahti hai. Dhyan dein tasniya par: صَديقَتانِ (do saheliyan).
intro.ar: نَصٌّ عَنْ صَديقَتَيْنِ: سارَةُ نَحيفَةٌ جِدّاً وَتُريدُ أَنْ يَزيدَ وَزْنُها، وَهُدى سَمينَةٌ وَتُريدُ أَنْ يَنْقُصَ وَزْنُها. لاحِظِ المُثَنّى: صَديقَتانِ.

dialogue.ar: سارَةُ وَهُدى صَديقَتانِ، وَبَيْنَهُما أَشْياءُ كَثيرَةٌ مُشْتَرَكَةٌ.
dialogue.tr: sāratu wahudā ṣadīqatāni, wabaynahumā ashay'u kathīratun mushtarakatun.
dialogue.en: Sara and Huda are friends, and they share many things.
dialogue.ur: Sara aur Huda saheliyan hain aur dono mein bohat si baatein ek jaisi hain.

dialogue.ar: هُما جارَتانِ في شارِعٍ واحِدٍ، وَتَذْهَبانِ كُلَّ صَباحٍ إِلَى المَدْرَسَةِ نَفْسِها.
dialogue.tr: humā jāratāni fī shāriʿin wāḥidin, watadhhabāni kulla ṣabāḥin ilā l-madrasati nafsihā.
dialogue.en: They are neighbours in one street, and every morning they go to the same school.
dialogue.ur: Dono ek hi gali ki parosan hain aur har subah ek hi school jaati hain.

dialogue.ar: لَكِنَّ بَيْنَهُما فَرْقاً واضِحاً: سارَةُ نَحيفَةٌ، وَهُدى سَمينَةٌ.
dialogue.tr: lakinna baynahumā farqan wāḍiḥan: sāratu naḥīfatun, wahudā samīnatun.
dialogue.en: But there is a clear difference between them: Sara is thin and Huda is heavy.
dialogue.ur: Lekin dono mein saaf farq hai: Sara dubli hai aur Huda moti hai.

dialogue.ar: تُريدُ سارَةُ أَنْ يَزيدَ وَزْنُها قَليلاً، لَكِنَّ ذَلِكَ صَعْبٌ عَلَيْها.
dialogue.tr: turīdu sāratu an yazīda waznuhā qalīlan, lakinna dhālika ṣaʿbun ʿalayhā.
dialogue.en: Sara wants her weight to go up a little, but that is hard for her.
dialogue.ur: Sara chahti hai ke uska wazan thoda barhe, lekin yeh uske liye mushkil hai.

dialogue.ar: أَمّا هُدى فَتُريدُ أَنْ يَنْقُصَ وَزْنُها، وَلا تَسْتَطيعُ هِيَ أَيْضاً.
dialogue.tr: ammā hudā faturīdu an yanquṣa waznuhā, walā tastaṭīʿu hiya ayḍan.
dialogue.en: As for Huda, she wants her weight to go down, and she cannot either.
dialogue.ur: Rahi Huda, woh chahti hai ke uska wazan kam ho, aur woh bhi nahi kar paati.

dialogue.ar: وَزْنُ سارَةَ ثَلاثَةٌ وَأَرْبَعونَ كيلو، فَكَيْفَ تَزيدُهُ؟
dialogue.tr: waznu sārata thalāthatun wa'arbaʿūna kīlū, fakayfa tazīduhu?
dialogue.en: Sara's weight is forty-three kilos, so how can she increase it?
dialogue.ur: Sara ka wazan teintalees kilo hai, to woh ise kaise barhaye?

dialogue.ar: بَدَأَتْ سارَةُ تَأْكُلُ أَكْثَرَ: اللَّحْمَ وَالسَّمَكَ وَالبَيْضَ وَالأَرُزَّ وَالجُبْنَ وَالفاكِهَةَ وَالحَلْوَى.
dialogue.tr: bada'at sāratu ta'kulu akthara: al-laḥma was-samaka wal-bayḍa wal-'aruzza wal-jubna wal-fākihata wal-ḥalwā.
dialogue.en: Sara began to eat more: meat, fish, eggs, rice, cheese, fruit and sweets.
dialogue.ur: Sara ne zyada khana shuru kiya: gosht, machhli, ande, chawal, paneer, phal aur mithai.

dialogue.ar: لَكِنَّ وَزْنَها لَمْ يَزِدْ كيلو واحِداً، مَعَ أَنَّها تَأْكُلُ كَثيراً.
dialogue.tr: lakinna waznahā lam yazid kīlū wāḥidan, maʿa annahā ta'kulu kathīran.
dialogue.en: But her weight did not go up even one kilo, although she eats a lot.
dialogue.ur: Lekin uska wazan ek kilo bhi nahi barha, halanke woh bohat khaati hai.

dialogue.ar: وَمُشْكِلَةُ هُدى غَيْرُ ذَلِكَ: وَزْنُها الآنَ خَمْسَةٌ وَثَمانونَ كيلو.
dialogue.tr: wamushkilatu hudā ghayru dhālika: waznuhā l-'āna khamsatun wathamānūna kīlū.
dialogue.en: Huda's problem is different: her weight now is eighty-five kilos.
dialogue.ur: Huda ka masla alag hai: uska wazan ab pachaasi kilo hai.

dialogue.ar: اِمْتَنَعَتْ هُدى عَنِ الحَلْوَى وَالخُبْزِ، وَمَشَتْ كُلَّ مَساءٍ أُسْبوعَيْنِ، لَكِنَّ وَزْنَها بَقِيَ كَما هُوَ.
dialogue.tr: imtanaʿat hudā ʿani l-ḥalwā wal-khubzi, wamashat kulla masā'in usbūʿayni, lakinna waznahā baqiya kamā huwa.
dialogue.en: Huda stayed away from sweets and bread and walked every evening for two weeks, but her weight stayed as it was.
dialogue.ur: Huda mithai aur roti se door rahi aur do hafte har shaam chali, lekin uska wazan jyun ka tyun raha.

intro.en: To make a present-tense verb negative, put «لا» before it. Example: مَرْيَمُ تُحِبُّ الأَكْلَ → زَيْنَبُ لا تُحِبُّ الأَكْلَ. What comes after «لا» is negated.
intro.ur: Mazaare (maujooda) fe'l ko manfi banane ke liye uske pehle «لا» lagate hain. Misaal: مَرْيَمُ تُحِبُّ الأَكْلَ → زَيْنَبُ لا تُحِبُّ الأَكْلَ.
intro.ar: لِنَفْيِ الفِعْلِ المُضارِعِ نَضَعُ «لا» قَبْلَهُ. مِثالٌ: مَرْيَمُ تُحِبُّ الأَكْلَ، وَزَيْنَبُ لا تُحِبُّ الأَكْلَ. ما يَأْتي بَعْدَ «لا» يَصيرُ مَنْفِيّاً.

q.en: How do you say 'I do not work in a company'?
q.ur: 'Main company mein kaam nahi karta' kaise kahenge?
q.ar: كَيْفَ تَقولُ: أَنا لا أَعْمَلُ في شَرِكَةٍ؟

intro.en: A patient with a headache visits the doctor, who finds high blood pressure and sugar. The doctor gives him a plan: a lighter diet, daily walking and medicine. A month later he returns and is better. Notice «لابُدَّ مِنْ» (it is necessary to).
intro.ur: Sar dard ka ek mareez doctor ke paas aata hai. Doctor ko blood pressure aur sugar zyada milta hai aur woh use ek plan deta hai: halki khuraak, rozana sair aur dawa. Ek mahine baad mareez behtar hota hai. Dhyan dein «لابُدَّ مِنْ» (zaroori hai).
intro.ar: يَزورُ مَريضٌ يَشْكو مِنَ الصُّداعِ الطَّبيبَ، فَيَجِدُ ضَغْطَهُ وَالسُّكَّرَ مُرْتَفِعَيْنِ، وَيَضَعُ لَهُ خُطَّةً: حِمْيَةً وَمَشْياً وَدَواءً. وَبَعْدَ شَهْرٍ يَعودُ وَقَدْ تَحَسَّنَتْ حالَتُهُ. لاحِظْ «لابُدَّ مِنْ».

dialogue.ar: أَهْلاً بِكَ يا أُسْتاذ مَنْصور. ماذا تَشْكو؟
dialogue.tr: ahlan bika yā ustādh manṣūr. mādhā tashkū?
dialogue.en: Welcome, Mr Mansour. What is troubling you?
dialogue.ur: Khush aamdeed Mansour sahab. Aapko kya takleef hai?

dialogue.ar: أَشْعُرُ بِصُداعٍ وَتَعَبٍ مُنْذُ أُسْبوعَيْنِ يا دُكْتور.
dialogue.tr: ashʿuru biṣudāʿin wataʿabin mundhu usbūʿayni yā duktūr.
dialogue.en: I have felt a headache and tiredness for two weeks, doctor.
dialogue.ur: Doctor sahab, do hafton se mujhe sar dard aur thakan mehsoos ho rahi hai.

dialogue.ar: فَحَصْتُكَ الآنَ، وَضَغْطُكَ مُرْتَفِعٌ، وَعِنْدَكَ السُّكَّرِيُّ أَيْضاً.
dialogue.tr: faḥaṣtuka l-'āna, waḍaghṭuka murtafiʿun, waʿindaka s-sukkariyyu ayḍan.
dialogue.en: I examined you just now: your pressure is high and you have diabetes too.
dialogue.ur: Maine abhi aapka muayna kiya: aapka pressure zyada hai aur aapko sugar ki bimari bhi hai.

dialogue.ar: هَلِ الأَمْرُ خَطيرٌ؟
dialogue.tr: hali l-'amru khaṭīrun?
dialogue.en: Is the matter serious?
dialogue.ur: Kya yeh baat sangeen hai?

dialogue.ar: حالَتُكَ تَحْتاجُ إِلَى اهْتِمامٍ. أَعْتَقِدُ أَنَّكَ تَأْكُلُ كَثيراً وَلا تَمْشي أَبَداً.
dialogue.tr: ḥālatuka taḥtāju ilā htimāmin. aʿtaqidu annaka ta'kulu kathīran walā tamshī abadan.
dialogue.en: Your condition needs attention. I believe you eat a lot and never walk.
dialogue.ur: Aapki halat tawajjoh chahti hai. Mera khayal hai aap bohat khate hain aur kabhi paidal nahi chalte.

dialogue.ar: هَذا صَحيحٌ، أَجْلِسُ في المَكْتَبِ طَوالَ اليَوْمِ، وَأَشْرَبُ الشّايَ بِالسُّكَّرِ دائِماً.
dialogue.tr: hādhā ṣaḥīḥun, ajlisu fī l-maktabi ṭawla l-yawmi, wa'ashrabu sh-shāya bis-sukkari dā'iman.
dialogue.en: That is true. I sit in the office all day and I always drink tea with sugar.
dialogue.ur: Yeh sach hai, main saara din daftar mein baitha rehta hoon aur hamesha cheeni wali chai peeta hoon.

dialogue.ar: لابُدَّ مِنْ تَقْليلِ السُّكَّرِ، وَلابُدَّ مِنَ المَشْيِ نِصْفَ ساعَةٍ كُلَّ يَوْمٍ.
dialogue.tr: lābudda min taqlīli s-sukkari, walābudda mina l-mashyi niṣfa sāʿatin kulla yawmin.
dialogue.en: You must cut down on sugar, and you must walk half an hour every day.
dialogue.ur: Cheeni kam karna zaroori hai aur rozana aadha ghanta chalna bhi zaroori hai.

dialogue.ar: أَنا مَشْغولٌ دائِماً، وَلَمْ أَجِدِ الوَقْتَ لِذَلِكَ.
dialogue.tr: anā mashghūlun dā'iman, walam ajidi l-waqta lidhālika.
dialogue.en: I am always busy, and I did not find the time for that.
dialogue.ur: Main hamesha masroof rehta hoon aur mujhe iske liye waqt nahi mila.

dialogue.ar: اِتَّبِعْ هَذِهِ الخُطَّةَ: حِمْيَةٌ خَفيفَةٌ، وَمَشْيٌ يَوْمِيٌّ، وَدَواءٌ في مَوْعِدِهِ. ثُمَّ زُرْني بَعْدَ شَهْرٍ.
dialogue.tr: ittabiʿ hādhihi l-khuṭṭata: ḥimyatun khafīfatun, wamashyun yawmiyyun, wadaw'un fī mawʿidihi. thumma zurnī baʿda shahrin.
dialogue.en: Follow this plan: a light diet, daily walking and medicine on time. Then visit me after a month.
dialogue.ur: Is plan par chalein: halki khuraak, rozana sair aur waqt par dawa. Phir ek mahine baad mujhse milein.

dialogue.ar: سَأَفْعَلُ ذَلِكَ إِنْ شاءَ اللهُ.
dialogue.tr: sa'afʿalu dhālika in shā'a llāh.
dialogue.en: I will do that, God willing.
dialogue.ur: Main yeh karunga, inshaAllah.

dialogue.ar: (بَعْدَ شَهْرٍ) ما شاءَ اللهُ! الضَّغْطُ عادِيٌّ الآنَ، وَالسُّكَّرُ أَحْسَنُ بِكَثيرٍ.
dialogue.tr: baʿda shahrin) mā shā'a llāh! aḍ-ḍaghṭu ʿādiyyun al-'āna, was-sukkaru aḥsanu bikathīrin.
dialogue.en: (After a month) Masha'Allah! The pressure is normal now and the sugar is much better.
dialogue.ur: (Ek mahine baad) MashaAllah! Ab pressure normal hai aur sugar bhi bohat behtar hai.

dialogue.ar: اِتَّبَعْتُ الخُطَّةَ كُلَّها: قَلَّلْتُ السُّكَّرَ، وَمَشَيْتُ كُلَّ يَوْمٍ، وَأَخَذْتُ الدَّواءَ.
dialogue.tr: ittabaʿtu l-khuṭṭata kullahā: qallaltu s-sukkara, wamashaytu kulla yawmin, wa'akhadhtu d-daw'a.
dialogue.en: I followed the whole plan: I cut down sugar, walked every day and took the medicine.
dialogue.ur: Maine poora plan apnaya: cheeni kam ki, rozana chala aur dawa li.

dialogue.ar: أَحْسَنْتَ! حافِظْ عَلى ذَلِكَ، وَقابِلْني بَعْدَ ثَلاثَةِ أَشْهُرٍ.
dialogue.tr: aḥsanta! ḥāfiẓ ʿalā dhālika, waqābilnī baʿda thalāthati ashhurin.
dialogue.en: Well done! Keep it up, and meet me after three months.
dialogue.ur: Shabash! Isi par qaaim rahein aur teen mahine baad mujhse milein.

dialogue.ar: شُكْراً جَزيلاً يا دُكْتور، وَبارَكَ اللهُ فيكَ.
dialogue.tr: shukran jazīlan yā duktūr, wabāraka llāh fīka.
dialogue.en: Many thanks, doctor, and may Allah bless you.
dialogue.ur: Bohat shukriya doctor sahab, Allah aapko barkat de.

q.en: What must the patient do every day, according to the doctor?
q.ur: Doctor ke mutabiq mareez ko rozana kya karna chahiye?
q.ar: ماذا يَجِبُ عَلى المَريضِ أَنْ يَفْعَلَ كُلَّ يَوْمٍ بِحَسَبِ الطَّبيبِ؟
ماذا يَجِبُ عَلى المَريضِ أَنْ يَفْعَلَ؟

options: Follow a diet, exercise and take medicine
options_ar: أَنْ يَتَّبِعَ حِمْيَةً وَيُمارِسَ الرِّياضَةَ وَيَتَناوَلَ الدَّواءَ

intro.en: A verb has a time: past (الماضي), present (الحاضر) and future (المستقبل). To make the future, add سَـ or سَوْفَ before the present verb. Example: يُسافِرُ (he travels) → سَيُسافِرُ / سَوْفَ يُسافِرُ (he will travel).
intro.ur: Fe'l ka ek zamana hota hai: maazi (guzra), haazir (abhi) aur mustaqbil (aane wala). Mustaqbil banane ke liye mazaare se pehle سَـ ya سَوْفَ lagate hain. Misaal: يُسافِرُ → سَيُسافِرُ (woh safar karega).
intro.ar: لِلْفِعْلِ زَمَنٌ: الماضي وَالحاضِرُ (المُضارِعُ) وَالمُسْتَقْبَلُ. وَنَصْنَعُ المُسْتَقْبَلَ بِإِضافَةِ سَـ أَوْ سَوْفَ قَبْلَ الفِعْلِ المُضارِعِ. مِثالٌ: يُسافِرُ ← سَيُسافِرُ / سَوْفَ يُسافِرُ.

q.en: Complete: أَخي ___ غَداً إِلَى مَكَّةَ (will travel)
q.ur: Mukammal karein: أَخي ___ غَداً إِلَى مَكَّةَ
q.ar: أَكْمِلْ بِفِعْلٍ يَدُلُّ عَلى المُسْتَقْبَلِ: أَخي ___ غَداً إِلى مَكَّةَ

q.ur: Mukammal karein: هُدَى ___ الكِتابَ قَبْلَ يَوْمَيْنِ
q.ar: أَكْمِلْ بِفِعْلٍ ماضٍ: هُدَى ___ الكِتابَ قَبْلَ يَوْمَيْنِ

q.en: Which two words make the future?

intro.en: Listen to the dialogue between Fatima and the doctor, then circle the correct answer. Fatima felt pain; the doctor gives her a paper listing types of medicine.
intro.ur: Fatima aur doctora ki guftagu sunein, phir sahi jawab par ghera lagayein. Fatima ko dard hua; doctora ne use dawaon ki qismon ki parchi di.
intro.ar: اِسْتَمِعْ إِلى الحِوارِ بَيْنَ فاطِمَةَ وَالطَّبيبَةِ، ثُمَّ اخْتَرِ الإِجابَةَ الصَّحيحَةَ. شَعَرَتْ فاطِمَةُ بِأَلَمٍ، فَأَعْطَتْها الطَّبيبَةُ وَرَقَةً فيها أَنْواعُ الأَدْوِيَةِ.

intro.en: Pair activity: say what each person does, then compare two pictures. Example: شَخْصٌ يَشْعُرُ بِآلامٍ شَديدَةٍ في البَطْنِ (a person feeling severe stomach pain). Describe using words like نَحيف and سَمين.
intro.ur: Jodi ke saath mashq: har shakhs kya karta hai batayein, phir do tasveerein mawazna karein. Misaal: شَخْصٌ يَشْعُرُ بِآلامٍ شَديدَةٍ في البَطْنِ (ek shakhs jise pet mein shadeed dard hai).
intro.ar: نَشاطٌ مَعَ زَميلٍ: قُلْ ماذا يَفْعَلُ كُلُّ شَخْصٍ، ثُمَّ قارِنْ بَيْنَ صورَتَيْنِ. مِثالٌ: شَخْصٌ يَشْعُرُ بِآلامٍ شَديدَةٍ في البَطْنِ. صِفْ بِكَلِماتٍ مِثْلِ: نَحيف وَسَمين.

q.en: «شَخْصٌ مَريضٌ بِالبَدانَةِ» means a person who is…

q.ur: «شَخْصٌ يُريدُ أَنْ يَكونَ صَحيحاً» ka matlab…
q.ar: ما معنى «شَخْصٌ يُريدُ أَنْ يَكونَ صَحيحاً»؟

options: a person who wants to be healthy
a person who wants to travel
options_ar: شَخْصٌ يُريدُ أَنْ يَكونَ سَليماً مُعافىً

q.en: What does «قارِنْ بَيْنَ الصّورَتَيْنِ» ask you to do?
q.ar: ماذا يَطْلُبُ مِنْكَ قَوْلُهُ «قارِنْ بَيْنَ الصّورَتَيْنِ»؟

intro.en: A word (الكَلِمَة) has three kinds: noun (اِسْم), verb (فِعْل) and particle (حَرْف). Examples: مُحَمَّد = noun, جَلَسَ = verb, في = particle.
intro.ur: Kalima ki teen qismein hain: ism (اِسْم), fe'l (فِعْل) aur harf (حَرْف). Misaal: مُحَمَّد = ism, جَلَسَ = fe'l, في = harf.
intro.ar: الكَلِمَةُ ثَلاثَةُ أَنْواعٍ: اِسْمٌ وَفِعْلٌ وَحَرْفٌ. أَمْثِلَةٌ: مُحَمَّد اِسْمٌ، جَلَسَ فِعْلٌ، في حَرْفٌ.

q.en: How many kinds of words are there?

intro.en: A reading text: in the past a big body was thought to be a sign of health; today doctors warn against eating too much. The text ends with the Qur'anic verse «وَكُلوا وَاشْرَبوا وَلا تُسْرِفوا» and a hadith of the Prophet ﷺ about not over-filling the stomach.
intro.ur: Ek parhne ka matan: pehle bhaari jism ko sehat ki nishani samjha jata tha, aaj doctor zyada khane se khabardaar karte hain. Matan ke aakhir mein Quran ki aayat «وَكُلوا وَاشْرَبوا وَلا تُسْرِفوا» aur pet ko zyada na bharne ke baare mein Nabi ﷺ ki hadees hai.
intro.ar: نَصٌّ عَنِ الصِّحَّةِ: كانَ النّاسُ قَديماً يَظُنّونَ أَنَّ الجِسْمَ الكَبيرَ عَلامَةُ الصِّحَّةِ، وَالآنَ يُحَذِّرُ الأَطِبّاءُ مِنَ الإِكْثارِ مِنَ الطَّعامِ. وَفي النَّصِّ آيَةٌ كَريمَةٌ وَحَديثٌ شَريفٌ.

dialogue.ar: كانَ النّاسُ قَديماً يَظُنّونَ أَنَّ الجِسْمَ الكَبيرَ عَلامَةُ الصِّحَّةِ وَالقُوَّةِ.
dialogue.tr: kāna n-nāsu qadīman yaẓunnūna anna l-jisma l-kabīra ʿalāmatu ṣ-ṣiḥḥati wal-quwwati.
dialogue.en: In the past people thought that a big body was a sign of health and strength.
dialogue.ur: Pehle log samajhte the ke bada jism sehat aur taaqat ki nishani hai.

dialogue.ar: وَكانوا يَفْرَحونَ بِالطِّفْلِ الَّذي يَأْكُلُ كَثيراً، وَيَقولونَ: إِنَّهُ بِصِحَّةٍ جَيِّدَةٍ.
dialogue.tr: wakānū yafraḥūna biṭ-ṭifli lladhī ya'kulu kathīran, wayaqūlūna: innahu biṣiḥḥatin jayyidatin.
dialogue.en: They were happy with the child who ate a lot, and they said: he is in good health.
dialogue.ur: Woh us bachche se khush hote the jo bohat khata tha aur kehte the: uski sehat achhi hai.

dialogue.ar: ثُمَّ تَطَوَّرَ الطِّبُّ، وَعَرَفَ العُلَماءُ أَنَّ الإِكْثارَ مِنَ الطَّعامِ سَبَبٌ لِأَمْراضٍ كَثيرَةٍ.
dialogue.tr: thumma taṭawwara ṭ-ṭibbu, waʿarafa l-ʿulamā'u anna l-'ikthāra mina ṭ-ṭaʿāmi sababun li'amrāḍin kathīratin.
dialogue.en: Then medicine developed, and scientists learned that eating too much is a cause of many diseases.
dialogue.ur: Phir tibb ne taraqqi ki aur ulama ko maloom hua ke zyada khana bohat si bimariyon ki wajah hai.

dialogue.ar: وَأَصْبَحَ كَثيرٌ مِنَ الأَطِبّاءِ يُحَذِّرونَ مِنَ الإِسْرافِ في الحَلْوَياتِ وَالدُّهونِ.
dialogue.tr: wa'aṣbaḥa kathīrun mina l-'aṭibbā'i yuḥadhdhirūna mina l-'isrāfi fī l-ḥalwayti wad-duhūni.
dialogue.en: And many doctors began to warn against excess in sweets and fats.
dialogue.ur: Aur bohat se doctor meethe aur chikni cheezon mein hadd se barhne se khabardaar karne lage.

dialogue.ar: وَيَنْصَحونَ بِالخُضْراواتِ وَالفاكِهَةِ، وَبِأَنْ نَأْكُلَ قَليلاً وَنَتَحَرَّكَ كَثيراً.
dialogue.tr: wayanṣaḥūna bil-khuḍrāawti wal-fākihati, wabi'an na'kula qalīlan wanataḥarraka kathīran.
dialogue.en: They advise vegetables and fruit, and that we eat little and move a lot.
dialogue.ur: Woh sabziyon aur phalon ka mashwara dete hain aur yeh ke hum kam khayen aur zyada harkat karein.

dialogue.ar: فَاِبْتَعَدَ كَثيرٌ مِنَ النّاسِ عَنِ الأَطْعِمَةِ الدَّسِمَةِ، وَاتَّجَهوا إِلَى الأَكْلِ الصِّحّيِّ.
dialogue.tr: fābtaʿada kathīrun mina n-nāsi ʿani l-'aṭʿimati d-dasimati, wāttajahū ilā l-'akli ṣ-ṣiḥḥyyi.
dialogue.en: So many people moved away from fatty foods and turned to healthy eating.
dialogue.ur: Chunancha bohat se log chikni ghizaon se door ho gaye aur sehatmand khane ki taraf aa gaye.

dialogue.ar: وَالإِسْلامُ يَدْعو إِلَى الاعْتِدالِ في الطَّعامِ وَالشَّرابِ.
dialogue.tr: wal-'islāmu yadʿū ilā l-ʿtidāli fī ṭ-ṭaʿāmi wash-sharābi.
dialogue.en: Islam calls for moderation in food and drink.
dialogue.ur: Islam khane peene mein etidal ki dawat deta hai.

dialogue.ar: قالَ تَعالَى: ﴿وَكُلُوا وَاشْرَبُوا وَلَا تُسْرِفُوا  إِنَّهُ لَا يُحِبُّ الْمُسْرِفِينَ﴾.
dialogue.tr: qāla taʿālā: wa kulū washrabū wa lā tusrifū innahu lā yuḥibbu l-musrifīn
dialogue.en: Allah the Most High said: 'Eat and drink but do not be wasteful; He does not love the wasteful.'
dialogue.ur: Allah Ta'ala ne farmaya: 'Khao aur piyo magar fuzool kharchi na karo, woh fuzool kharch karne walon ko pasand nahi karta.'

dialogue.ar: وَقالَ الرَّسولُ ﷺ: «ما مَلَأَ آدَمِيٌّ وِعاءً شَرّاً مِنْ بَطْنِهِ».
dialogue.tr: wa qāla r-rasūlu ṣallā llāhu ʿalayhi wa sallam: mā mala'a ādamiyyun wiʿā'an sharran min baṭnih
dialogue.en: The Messenger ﷺ said: 'No human being fills a vessel worse than his stomach.'
dialogue.ur: Rasool ﷺ ne farmaya: 'Kisi insan ne apne pet se bura bartan nahi bhara.'

q.en: In the past, what was a sign of health?
q.ur: Pehle sehat ki alamat kya thi?

options: Eating too much causes many diseases
Eating a lot makes people strong
options_ar: الإِكْثارُ مِنَ الطَّعامِ سَبَبٌ لِأَمْراضٍ كَثيرَةٍ

q.en: What do the doctors warn against?
q.ur: Doctor kis cheez se khabardaar karte hain?
Islam kis ki daawat deta hai?

options: Eat and drink but do not be wasteful

intro.en: Learn the punctuation marks: full stop (نُقْطَة), question mark (عَلامَةُ اسْتِفْهامٍ), comma (فاصِلَة) and exclamation mark (عَلامَةُ تَعَجُّبٍ). Also a spelling note: alif maqsura (ى) in verbs like مَشَى changes to ي in the present: يَمْشي.
intro.ur: Alamat-e-tarqeem seekhein: nuqta (نُقْطَة)، sawaliya nishan (عَلامَةُ اسْتِفْهامٍ)، comma (فاصِلَة)، tajjub ka nishan (عَلامَةُ تَعَجُّبٍ). Imla: alif maqsura (ى) wale fe'l jaise مَشَى mazaare mein ي ban jaate hain: يَمْشي.
intro.ar: تَتَعَلَّمُ عَلاماتِ التَّرْقيمِ: النُّقْطَةُ، وَعَلامَةُ الاسْتِفْهامِ، وَالفاصِلَةُ، وَعَلامَةُ التَّعَجُّبِ. وَقاعِدَةٌ إِمْلائِيَّةٌ: الأَلِفُ المَقْصورَةُ (ى) في الفِعْلِ مَشَى تَصيرُ ياءً في المُضارِعِ: يَمْشي.
